name: Qiskit QFT on a 3-qubit entangled GHZ state
task_prompt: Use Qiskit computational-basis statevector indexing. ghz_circuit prepares (|0...0> + |1...1>)/sqrt(2). qft_circuit implements the forward n-qubit QFT without final swaps. ghz_then_qft_circuit composes those circuits and ghz_then_qft_statevector returns its statevector. For n=3, the amplitude at integer basis index k is (1 + exp(2*pi*i*7*k/8))/4. amplitude_histogram uses zero-padded n-bit keys and includes exactly the amplitudes whose absolute value is greater than tol.
